brief: The new infra stack for AI startups in 2026 — bye Heroku, hello Cloudflare.

slots.title: 1. Cloudflare, the edge layer
slots.body: Ditch Heroku. Deploy Workers close to users for sub-50ms cold starts and zero scaling limits. Your backend now lives on 300+ cities.

slots.title: 2. Supabase, the Postgres backend
slots.body: Managed Postgres with realtime websockets, vector extensions for RAG, and Row Level Security. Stop babysitting database clusters.

slots.title: 3. Vercel, the frontend engine
slots.body: Ship Next.js apps with global CDN, instant previews, and edge middleware. Frontend deploys in seconds, not minutes.

slots.title: 4. OpenAI, the model layer
slots.body: GPT-5 and o3 reasoning APIs handle inference without self-hosted GPUs. Pay per token and scale to millions of requests.

slots.title: 5. LangChain, the AI glue
slots.body: Chain prompts, tools, and retrieval into reliable agents. It turns raw LLM calls into production-grade workflows fast.

slots.title: 6. Stripe, the revenue engine
slots.body: Billing, subscriptions, and usage-based pricing out of the box. Focus on product while Stripe handles global payments compliance.

slots.headline: Ship your AI startup today
slots.subline: Save this framework and start building on the edge. No Heroku required.
